lines.en: Chewing on dry leaves, a raspy sound.

lines.zh: 在阳光下晒背，发出吱吱声。
寻找食物，发出轻微咀嚼声。
lines.en: Chewing softly while searching for food.
Crunching along quickly, a crackle sound.

lines.zh: 缓慢移动，发出微弱的嗡嗡声。
在洞穴入口休息，发出轻微咀嚼声。
lines.en: Chewing softly by the cave entrance.

lines.zh: 在腐木上蠕动，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Crawling on rotting wood, a hiss sound.

lines.zh: 爬行于枯枝上，发出细碎声响。
lines.en: Crawling on dry twigs, a crackling sound
Hundreds of thin legs shift together.
I crawl along a spent shell casing.
Gunpowder drowns out the smell of soil.
I slip into a brick crack and out again.
The swarm gathers into one dark patch.
I crawl over a barrel just gone cool.

lines.zh: 静止不动，偶尔发出嘶嘶声。
慵懒地躺着，发出轻微的吱吱声。
lines.en: Lazy on its back, a faint squeak.

lines.zh: 静静地待在角落，发出细微嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Quiet in the corner, a soft hiss.

lines.zh: 趴在地上，发出细微的呼吸声。
lines.en: Lying on the ground, a faint breathing sound.

lines.zh: 在暗处静止不动，发出微弱嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Quiet in the dark, a faint hiss.

lines.zh: 静静地趴着，偶尔发出轻声。
lines.en: Silent, occasionally making a soft sound.

lines.zh: 懒洋洋地躺着，偶尔轻喘。
lines.en: Lazy on its back, occasionally panting softly.

lines.zh: 在暗处等待，发出微弱嗡嗡声。
lines.en: Quiet in the dark, a faint buzz.

lines.zh: 静静地趴着，偶尔轻声嘶嘶。
我们叠成一层，腿缠着腿。
lines.en: We stack in a layer, legs tangled in legs.
Chitin rasps a thin, dry sound.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家，发出尖锐嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Sudden hiss when noticing the player.

lines.zh: 几十双眼睛同时对着你。
lines.en: Dozens of eyes point at you at once.

lines.zh: 朝玩家方向，发出微弱嗡嗡声。
lines.en: Buzzing softly in the player's direction.
Hissing softly when looking at the player.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，发出尖锐嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Sharp hiss upon spotting the player.

lines.zh: 朝玩家看去，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Hisses softly when looking at the player.
The whole swarm looks up at you at once.
Fixes on the player, hissing softly.
Hisses softly upon seeing the player

lines.zh: 你手里拿着会响的棍子。
lines.en: You hold a stick that makes noise.
There's a hole in my wing; I can't fly straight.

lines.zh: 我这点翅膀，挨一发就散。
lines.en: These wings scatter after a single shot.

lines.zh: 被雷劈了，我这几只小虫更疯了。
lines.en: Struck by lightning, and these few bugs went crazier.
A crack has opened in my shell.

lines.zh: 嗡嗡作响，你挡了我的路！
火药渣里还有一点甜味。
lines.en: There is a hint of sweetness in the powder grit.

lines.zh: 虫群炸弹一开，全是我同类。
lines.en: Pop the swarm bomb and my kin pour out.
Come on, let us find food together.

lines.zh: 别挡，我们正往枪管里钻。
lines.en: Do not block us; we are crawling into the barrel.

lines.zh: 你踩过来，我们散开又合拢。
lines.en: You step down; we scatter and close again.

lines.zh: 我们贴上去，分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: We press together until none of us is separate.

lines.zh: 虫群炸弹裂开，我们各找各的。
lines.en: The swarm bomb splits; we each find a partner.

lines.zh: 虫群炸弹一开，我们就有伴了。
lines.en: Crack a swarm bomb and we have company.

lines.zh: 虫群炸弹一开，同胞全出来。
lines.en: Crack the swarm bomb and my kin pour out.
We are part of the family!
The ground is slippery, watch out!

lines.zh: 你踢开一只，还有一整群。
lines.en: Kick one off, and the swarm remains.

lines.zh: 枪声一停，我们就扑上去。
lines.en: The shooting stops, and we rush in.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我们铺过去。
lines.en: You back to the corner; we spread over.

lines.zh: 火药味一浓，我们就知道该咬谁。
lines.en: When gunpowder thickens, we know who to bite.

lines.zh: 那根枪管里，有我们的味道。

lines.en: This pile of shells is our nest.
The gunshot woke every one of us.

lines.zh: 虫群炸开，我们全爬出来了。
lines.en: The swarm bomb bursts; we all crawl out.

lines.zh: 砖缝里全是我们的细腿。
lines.en: Our thin legs fill every brick crack.

lines.zh: 虫群炸弹炸开，我就是那些碎屑。
lines.en: The swarm bomb burst, and I am its debris.

lines.zh: 虫群炸弹一开，我们全出来。
lines.en: Pop the bomb and we all come out.
We close in from every side.
Locked in. It cannot slip free.

lines.zh: 炸弹壳一开，我们爬满地面。
lines.en: The bomb casing opens; we cover the ground.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我们的腿缩成一团。
lines.en: Fire makes our legs curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 虫子摔下来，壳还是硬的。
lines.en: The bug falls, and its shell still holds.

lines.zh: 虫群被炸散，我又聚起来。
lines.en: The swarm was scattered — I gather again.

lines.zh: 雷一落，整片虫群都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning falls and the whole swarm stiffens.
